title: G-rise
description: Master the Mace! A fast-paced vertical parkour where Wardens are your stepping stones.
body:
# G-Rise **Vertical Parkour | Bounce, Combo & Race! [1.21+]** ![](https://i.imgur.com/jnhd5F1.gif)
## Overview Give your players a real reason to master the Mace! G-Rise transforms the Wind Burst enchantment into a fast-paced vertical parkour minigame. Bounce off Wardens, build massive hit combos, and race to the top. The first fully customizable Wind Burst minigame designed for modern networks. ## Core Features - **Dynamic Spawning:** Entities spawn dynamically based on the player's height. - **Custom Physics:** Fully configurable Wind Burst multipliers and levitation rescue mechanics for stuck players. - **Combo System:** Build hit streaks to trigger custom commands (e.g., give diamonds at 50x combo) and ascending pitch sounds. - **Multi-Mode:** Easy, Medium, Hard, and Race (Multiplayer) difficulties. - **Database Support:** Save player stats (wins, best times) using local SQLite or remote MySQL.
![](https://i.imgur.com/TDtPVvt.gif)
## Commands & Permissions **Player Commands (`grise.use`):** - `/gr play [difficulty]` - Join an arena solo. - `/gr race ` - Join the multiplayer race queue. - `/gr leave` - Leave your current game. - `/gr stats [player]` - View stats. - `/gr top ` - Show the leaderboard. **Admin Commands (`grise.admin`):** - `/gr admin create/delete ` - Manage arenas. - `/gr admin setspawn/setgoal/setradius` - Configure the arena bounds. - `/gr admin setglow ` - Custom RGB glowing outline. - `/gr admin reload` - Reloads config. ## Documentation & Setup For a full setup guide, configuration details, and API usage, visit the official portal: **[Read the Official Documentation](https://myplugins.gexel.fun)**
*Crafted with focus on performance by _gengis*
